message:
in-addr-util: reimplement in_addr_prefix_range()

Currently, in_addr_prefix_range() is the only user of in_addr_prefix_nth(),
and it is too generic and complicated.
Previously, in_addr_prefix_range() calls in_addr_prefix_nth() with 0 and 1.
The function in_addr_prefix_nth(0) is equivalent to in_addr_mask(), and
in_addr_prefix_nth(1) is equivalent to just increment the masked value
with 1.
So, let's reimplement the code without using in_addr_prefix_nth().
